errors.evidence: The description claims the unit of the x-axis is percentage ("单位为百分比"), but no unit is specified on the chart. The values, which go up to nearly 400, make it impossible for the unit to be percentage.

The description states that the horizontal axis represents proportion values ("占比值"). However, the axis values range up to 400, indicating they are likely counts or frequencies, not proportions. While the chart title uses the word "占比" (proportion), this contradicts the visual data on the axis, which the description should prioritize.
